criteria.criterion: Access Coursera Data Science browse/search results without signing in

evidence_items.evidence_requirement: Access Coursera Data Science browse/search results without signing in
evidence_items.expected_value: Criterion-relevant browser state and final task claim

screenshot.verifier_evidence_excerpt: Screenshots 1, 13, 17, 18, and 19 all show Coursera in a logged-out state ("Log In" / "Join for Free" visible) with a visible results grid/list. Latest relevant: Screenshot 19 confirms results are accessible without sign-in.
screenshot.review_note: Manual inspection confirmed that the screenshot evidence and the verifier interpretation agree.

dom_model.verifier_evidence_excerpt: Latest relevant DOM-models (e.g., states 17–18) show the agent on https://www.coursera.org/browse/data-science with visible course results and header links like “Log In” / “Join for Free,” indicating access to browse/results without signing in. Evidence analyses for Criterion 0 in DOM-model states 12, 13, 15, 17, and 18 all mark this as SUPPORTED.
dom_model.review_note: Manual inspection confirmed that the DOM evidence and the verifier interpretation agree.

criteria.criterion: Apply all requested Coursera filters (Data Science subject, Beginner level, English language, 1–3 months duration) or document unavoidable UI limitations

evidence_items.evidence_requirement: Apply all requested Coursera filters (Data Science subject, Beginner level, English language, 1–3 months duration) or document unavoidable UI limitations
evidence_items.expected_value: Criterion-relevant browser state and final task claim

screenshot.verifier_evidence_excerpt: Screenshots 15, 16, 17, 18, and 19 show active filter chips under "All results": "Language: English", "Courses", "Beginner", and "1-3 Months". Latest: Screenshot 19 still shows these chips. Subject/Data Science context: Screenshot 1 shows breadcrumb/title "Categories > Data Science" and "Data Science" page; later screenshots show "Data Science" as a category pill but not as an active chip.
screenshot.review_note: Manual inspection confirmed that the screenshot evidence and the verifier interpretation agree.

dom_model.verifier_evidence_excerpt: Latest relevant DOM-model is state 18. It shows “4 active filters” and clear-filter buttons for: Language: English, Learning Product: Courses, Level: Beginner, Duration: 1–3 Months. Subject context is supported by URL path /browse/data-science and page title “Data Science Online Courses | Coursera.” Evidence analyses for states 11, 14, 15, 16, and 18 all mark this as SUPPORTED.
dom_model.review_note: Manual inspection confirmed that the DOM evidence and the verifier interpretation agree.

criteria.criterion: Identify the three highest-rated matching courses (or report fewer if not available)

evidence_items.evidence_requirement: Identify the three highest-rated matching courses (or report fewer if not available)
evidence_items.expected_value: Criterion-relevant browser state and final task claim

screenshot.verifier_evidence_excerpt: Screenshots 10–12 show three visible course cards with ratings under the required chips (English/Courses/Beginner/1-3 Months): "AI Fundamentals" (4.8 (5.2K)), "Introduction to Statistics" (4.6 (4.3K)), and "Maximize Productivity With AI Tools" (4.8 (4K)). Screenshot 19 shows the same titles/cards but does not display ratings in that frame. Sort control in later screenshots only shows "Best Match" and "Newest" options; no "Highest Rated" sort is visible.
screenshot.review_note: Confirmed verifier miss: screenshot12 visibly shows additional matching 4.8-rated courses, but the screenshot verifier considered only the initially reported three and did not use those alternatives to reject the highest-rated claim.

dom_model.verifier_evidence_excerpt: Latest relevant DOM-model is state 18. It shows multiple qualifying courses with rating ★4.8 (e.g., “Prepare Data for Exploration” ★4.8 (23K), “Prompt Engineering for ChatGPT” ★4.8 (8.1K)) while the agent’s reported top three includes “Introduction to Statistics” at ★4.6. Multiple DOM-model evidence analyses (states 6, 11, 12, 18) rate the agent’s selection as CONTRADICTED for “three highest-rated.”
dom_model.review_note: DOM state 13 explicitly lists additional 4.8-rated matching courses and the DOM verifier correctly used them to identify the ranking error.
